title: 马斯克如何将政府运作游戏化(2)
desc: 马斯克如何将政府运作游戏化(2)

paragraphs.en: Musk occasionally made the cross-fertilisation of the domains of games and government explicit.
paragraphs.zh: 马斯克偶尔会明确指出游戏和政府领域之间的相互借鉴与融合。

paragraphs.en: Days after Trump won his second term, he shared a clip that purportedly showed him mowing down masses of demons in Diablo 4.
paragraphs.zh: 特朗普赢得第二个任期几天后，他分享了一段视频，视频中他声称自己在《暗黑破坏神 4》中大杀四方，消灭了大批恶魔。

paragraphs.en: He appended a comment: "The goal of @Doge is to speedrun fixing the federal government."
paragraphs.zh: 他补充了一条评论：“政府效率部的目标是迅速修复联邦政府。”

paragraphs.en: Speedrunning is a popular spectator sport on livestreaming platforms such as Twitch that involves completing a game, or a portion of a game, as fast as possible.
paragraphs.zh: 速通是一种在Twitch等直播平台上广受欢迎的观赏性运动，它要求尽可能快地完成一款游戏或游戏的一部分。

paragraphs.en: It echoes Musk's managerial style: he prioritises speed at his companies, often by setting unrealistic deadlines and pushing his employees hard to meet them.
paragraphs.zh: 这呼应了马斯克的管理风格：他在公司中优先考虑速度，通常通过设定不切实际的截止日期并迫使员工努力实现它们。

paragraphs.en: He himself has invited the comparison: "Speedrunning Factorio in real life …" he tweeted in September 2020, referencing a game that involves building factories.
paragraphs.zh: 他自己也曾做过这样的比较：2020年9月，他在推特上写道："在现实生活中速通《异星工厂》……"，这里提到的是一款关于建造工厂的游戏。

paragraphs.en: Speedrunning also often depends on using loopholes.
paragraphs.zh: 速通游戏通常也依赖于游戏漏洞的利用。

paragraphs.en: Some games have glitches that enable you to skip levels, go through walls, or perform other shortcuts.
paragraphs.zh: 有些游戏存在漏洞，能让你跳过关卡、穿墙而过或使用其他捷径。

paragraphs.en: Others are vulnerable to "arbitrary code execution", an exploit where custom code is injected into a game's memory to change its behaviour.
paragraphs.zh: 其他的则容易受到“任意代码执行”攻击，这是一种漏洞，攻击者可将自定义代码注入游戏内存以改变其行为。

paragraphs.en: Which tricks are considered permissible depends on which corner of the speedrunning community you belong to.
paragraphs.zh: 哪些技巧被认为是允许的，取决于你属于速通社区的哪个圈子。

paragraphs.en: "Any%" is a term that means all glitches and exploits may be used.
paragraphs.zh: “Any%”是一个术语，意思是可以使用所有的漏洞和技巧。

paragraphs.en: Musk's Doge speedrun belonged to the "any%" category.
paragraphs.zh: 马斯克的政府效率部速通属于“any%”类别。

paragraphs.en: What that would mean became clear during Trump's second inauguration.
paragraphs.zh: 在特朗普的第二次就职典礼上，这一点的含义变得清晰起来。

paragraphs.en: Minutes after the ceremony began, programmers working for Doge requested access to the computer systems of the US Office of Personnel Management.
paragraphs.zh: 仪式开始几分钟后，为政府效率部工作的程序员请求访问美国人事管理办公室的计算机系统。

paragraphs.en: Within half an hour, they had taken possession of files with information about millions of federal workers.
paragraphs.zh: 不到半小时，他们就获取了包含数百万联邦工作人员信息的文件。

paragraphs.en: Days later, they also gained the authority to send out an email to all federal employees from a single address.
paragraphs.zh: 几天后，他们还获得了从一个单一地址向所有联邦雇员发送电子邮件的权限。

paragraphs.en: They used this power to make the same offer in the same language (subject line: fork in the road) that Musk had made at Twitter years earlier: quit with paid leave or face the likelihood of getting fired.
paragraphs.zh: 他们利用这一权力，用同样的措辞提出了与马斯克多年前在推特提出的相同提议：要么带薪离职，要么面临被解雇的可能性。

paragraphs.en: The pattern recurred across the federal government.
paragraphs.zh: 这种模式在联邦政府中反复出现。

paragraphs.en: Speaking to the World Governments Summit in Dubai by videocall in February 2025, Musk announced his intention to "delete entire agencies … If you don't remove the roots of the weed," he said, "then it's easy for the weed to grow back."
paragraphs.zh: 2025年2月，马斯克通过视频连线在迪拜世界政府峰会上发表讲话，宣布他打算"撤销整个机构……如果你不除掉杂草的根，"他说，"那么杂草很容易就会重新长出来。"

paragraphs.en: From the start, Musk made it a priority for Doge to gain access to databases and other digital infrastructure.
paragraphs.zh: 从一开始，马斯克就把让政府效率部能够获得数据库和其他数字基础设施的访问权限作为优先事项。

paragraphs.en: He often talked about the need to "control the computers", one source told the New Yorker.
paragraphs.zh: 一位消息人士告诉《纽约客》，他经常谈到“控制计算机”的必要性。

paragraphs.en: His surrogates surged into one agency after another with laptops in backpacks, sometimes hauling in mattresses for sleepovers.
paragraphs.zh: 他的代理人背着装有笔记本电脑的背包，涌入一家又一家机构，有时还搬来床垫以便过夜。

paragraphs.en: Establishing centralised command-and-control positions, they rolled out a playbook that can be summarised as: delete, automate and integrate.
paragraphs.zh: 他们设立了集中的指挥控制岗位，推出了一套可以概括为“删除、自动化和整合”的行动方案。

paragraphs.en: The logic of deletion was clearest in zero-based budgeting (ZBB), the method that Musk embraced at both Twitter and Doge.
paragraphs.zh: 在零基预算（ZBB）中，削减的逻辑最为清晰，马斯克在推特和政府效率部项目中都采用了这种方法。

paragraphs.en: Invented in the 1960s, ZBB forced every department to justify each expense anew rather than carrying budgets forward.
paragraphs.zh: 零基预算法发明于20世纪60年代，它要求每个部门重新审视每一项开支，而不是直接沿用以往的预算。

paragraphs.en: Long dismissed as unworkable, by 2024, Silicon Valley firms were claiming that new technology had finally made ZBB feasible.
paragraphs.zh: 长期被认为不可行的零基预算（ZBB），到了2024年，硅谷公司宣称新技术终于使其变得可行。

paragraphs.en: Manually analysing and justifying each budget item was terribly time-intensive.
paragraphs.zh: 手动分析并论证每一项预算内容极其耗时。

paragraphs.en: But with large language models (LLMs) and AI accounting tools, this process could be performed automatically. Budgets could be rebuilt by bot.
paragraphs.zh: 但借助大语言模型（LLMs）和人工智能会计工具，这一过程可以自动完成。预算可以由机器人重新编制。

paragraphs.en: According to Wired, Musk captured the computer systems of the US Treasury's Bureau of Fiscal Service in Doge's first month in the hopes of creating "a 'delete' button he could wield against any agency by cutting off its funding at the source".
paragraphs.zh: 据《连线》杂志报道，在政府效率部推出的第一个月，马斯克控制了美国财政部财政服务局的计算机系统，希望打造一个“删除按钮”，这样他就可以从源头上切断任何机构的资金，从而对其施加影响。

paragraphs.en: Some agencies, such as USAID, were effectively dissolved, fed into "the wood chipper", as Musk put it in a tweet.
paragraphs.zh: 一些机构，比如美国国际开发署，实际上已经被解散了，就像马斯克在一条推文中所说的，被“扔进了碎木机”。
